subject: SIG: completion plan & evidence checklist for ZenFin
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@zenfin.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@zenfin.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement at ZenFin has asked us to complete the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) packet as part of our security review. They gave a deadline of Nov 22 for finished responses and supporting evidence (SOC2 report, sample access logs, network diagram).

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to deliver the completed SIG spreadsheet and the four evidence items below by Nov 22? If not, what do you think is realistic? Also, procurement prefers weekly status updates — can you do a standing Friday check-in email until the packet is closed?

Requested evidence: SOC2 report (most recent), sample access logs for a 30-day window, high-level network diagram, and the SIG completed spreadsheet.

Appreciate a short plan (owners + dates).

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Senior IT Procurement Manager
ZenFin

--
Olivia Barnes
ZenFin | procurement@zenfin.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@zenfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence timeline

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the clear timeline. We're committed to meeting Nov 22. Proposed plan below:

- Today (Nov 9): Confirm scope and owners (this email).
- Nov 10–13: Security team fills SIG spreadsheet and collates evidence (SOC2, network diagram).
- Nov 13: Share initial draft of SIG and sample logs for review.
- Nov 16: Respond to any follow-up clarifying questions; ship final evidence package to procurement.
- Nov 22: Final sign-off cycle (we'll keep this as a hard drop-dead date if procurement needs extra time).

Owners: Monica Patel (security evidence + SIG answers), Rishi Malhotra (legal redlines / attestation text), Marissa Cole (commercial liaison / delivery coordination), me (overall owner & weekly status).

I'll upload documents to a shared Drive folder and send weekly Friday status emails as requested. If procurement needs anything earlier (e.g., live walkthrough of logs), we can schedule a 30-minute session.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence timeline

Team — quick internal standup note following Jonas' plan. Please see owners and action items below (I'll be tracking):

- Monica: SIG spreadsheet primary responder. Need initial answers for modules A,B,C by EOD Nov 12. Attach evidence pointers inline in the sheet.
- Monica/Rishi: Provide SOC2 report and any narrow-scope attestation text by Nov 12.
- Monica: Pull 30-day sample of access logs (scrubbed) and a short readme describing timestamp range and columns — target Nov 13.
- Jonas/Marissa: Prepare delivery email + link and confirm DocuSign wording if procurement wants an attestation.

Note: Keep attachments minimal — procurement prefers packaged artifacts rather than large raw dumps. We'll produce a CSV sample and a short access-log readme.

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@zenfin.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence timeline

Thanks Jonas/Marissa — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications from procurement:

- Can the sample access logs include both console and API token activity (anonymized)?
- We prefer to see a short mapping table that ties SIG questions to supporting evidence files (so reviewers don't have to search).
- If you can get an initial package by Nov 16 that would be ideal; Nov 22 is a firm final acceptance date after our review.

Link to procurement checklist: https://zenfin.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/Lists/SecurityChecklist/DispForm.aspx?ID=212

Would you be able to confirm by Monday which evidence files will be in the initial Nov 16 package?

Best,
Olivia
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence timeline

Hi Olivia — quick status update and initial package (see attachments). Per your ask, the Nov 16 initial package will include:

- SIG-Answers-Redwood-v1.4.xlsx (completed modules A–C; remaining modules flagged with questions)
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf (redacted cover page + auditor letter)
- access-logs-sample.csv (30-day window, user ids hashed)
- network-diagram.png (high-level internet-facing diagram)
- evidence-mapping tab inside the SIG spreadsheet that points each SIG question to a specific file or page.

Attachments (stubs):
- SIG-Answers-Redwood-v1.4.xlsx (XLSX)
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf (PDF, redacted)
- access-logs-sample.csv (CSV, scrubbed)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink (I placed the initial package in /ZenFin-SIG/Nov-16-release)

Next steps: Monica will follow up on any SIG questions flagged in the sheet (target Nov 16). Rishi will prepare a short attestation paragraph if procurement requires it. We'll send the Nov 16 delivery email and keep you posted on Friday status emails.

Team — received the initial package and mapping table from the Drive link. Procurement will start reviewing tomorrow and may have quick clarifying asks. Appreciate the fast turnaround and the weekly status cadence — that will help us keep the internal review moving.

Two small notes from a first pass:
- The access-logs-sample.csv looks good; thanks for hashing user IDs.
- Can you add a one-paragraph readme inside the folder that describes log retention policy and where the full logs live (e.g., internal SIEM link)? That will help our reviewers.

If you can drop that readme by end of day Tuesday (Nov 17) we should be on track for Nov 22.

Thanks again,
Olivia
